name: acad-furniture
description: Insert and manage parametric furniture blocks for hospitals, offices and residential interiors. Covers beds, chairs, desks, cabinets, sofas, tables, and medical equipment with inventory attributes (inv_id, type, note) and room-preset populators.
intent_examples: generic insert of any FURN-* block
wstaw meble w pokoj przez preset

tools_summary.name: insert_bed
tools_summary.description: Insert a hospital/residential bed. Types: 'standard' (900x2000), 'icu' (1000x2200 + head-monitor strip), 'bariatric' (1200x2200), 'pediatric' (700x1500), 'or' (operating table 550x2100 + trendelenburg), 'labour' (1050x2300 + stirrups). Defaults to layer A-FURN-BED + attributes {inv_id, type, room}.

tools_summary.name: insert_cabinet
tools_summary.description: Insert a cabinet / storage unit. Types: 'storage' (generic), 'medical' (with glass-door indicator), 'file' (with drawer lines), 'wardrobe' (with hanger-rail indicator). Configurable width/depth. Defaults width=800 depth=400 layer=A-FURN-CBT.

tools_summary.name: insert_chair
tools_summary.description: Insert a chair. Types: 'office' (550x550 swivel), 'armchair' (800x800), 'stool' (450x450 round), 'examination' (600x600 medical stool), 'wheelchair' (700x1100). Defaults to layer A-FURN-CHR.

tools_summary.name: insert_desk
tools_summary.description: Insert a desk at given position with configurable width/depth. Types: 'office', 'reception' (L-shaped counter 2400x800 + 1200x400 overhang), 'nurse-station' (3000x900 with raised edge). Defaults width=1600 depth=800 layer=A-FURN-DSK.

tools_summary.name: insert_furniture
tools_summary.description: Insert any catalog furniture block by its canonical name (e.g. 'FURN-BED-STD', 'FURN-CHAIR-OFFICE'). Generic entry-point used after list_furniture_catalog; most callers prefer the specialised insert_bed/insert_chair/... tools that infer a type.
intent: generic insert of any FURN-* block

tools_summary.name: insert_sofa
tools_summary.description: Insert a sofa. Types: 'lounge' (cushioned), 'clinic' (waiting-room, vinyl). Seats: 2, 3. Defaults seats=3 type=lounge layer=A-FURN-SFA.

tools_summary.name: insert_table
tools_summary.description: Insert a table. Shape: 'rectangle' / 'round' / 'square'. Types: 'meeting', 'coffee', 'dining', 'exam' (medical exam table - height strip + roll paper slot). Configurable width/depth. Defaults rectangle 1200x800 meeting, layer=A-FURN-TBL.

tools_summary.name: list_furniture_catalog
tools_summary.description: Enumerate the built-in furniture block catalog (hospital + office + residential). Read-only. Returns name, category (bed/chair/desk/cabinet/sofa/table/misc), domain (hospital/office/residential), default width/depth in mm, and a one-line description.

tools_summary.name: list_furniture_in_model
tools_summary.description: Enumerate all furniture BlockReferences currently in model-space (block names starting with 'FURN-'). Optionally filter by layer or by exact block name. Returns handle, block name, layer, position, rotation and any {inv_id, type, note} attribute values. Read-only.

tools_summary.name: populate_room
tools_summary.description: Furnishes a room with FURNITURE. For sanitary fittings - WCs, basins, showers, and the clearances they need - that is plumbing.populate_bathroom. Auto-populate a room with a furniture preset. Room is identified either by a closed polyline handle OR explicit bbox (min+max). Presets: 'ward-room' (2 beds + 2 nightstands + 1 armchair), 'icu-room' (1 ICU-bed + monitor cabinet + visitor chair), 'or-room' (OR-table + anaesthesia + instrument trolley), 'office' (desk + chair + file cabinet), 'reception' (reception-desk + 3 waiting chairs), 'waiting' (3 sofas + 1 coffee-table), 'consult' (desk + 2 chairs + exam table + cabinet). Returns handles of inserted items plus per-item layer assignment warnings.
intent: wstaw meble w pokoj przez preset
